extracted.intended_audience: attorneys/agents seeking reinstatement to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office; Office of Enrollment and Discipline staff
extracted.subtask_description: Evaluation and decision on petitions for reinstatement to practice before the USPTO under 37 CFR § 11.58, including verification of compliance with the regulation and Director review of the petition and record. Producing a petition that demonstrates compliance and furnishes the record material relevant to eligibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compliance with 37 CFR § 11.58
rubrics_metrics.description: The petitioner must comply with all provisions of 37 CFR § 11.58. (Page states: "Ms. Castle complied with all provisions of 37 CFR § 11.58 on or before May 8, 2015.")
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compliance with the specific regulatory requirements set forth in 37 CFR § 11.58 is a prerequisite for reinstatement. The decision cites timely compliance (on or before a specific date) as a factual basis for granting the petition. The page does not enumerate the individual provisions of § 11.58; the regulation itself contains the substantive requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing a Petition for Reinstatement
rubrics_metrics.description: A Petition for Reinstatement must be submitted to the Office of Enrollment and Discipline. (Page notes: "Consideration has been given to the Petition for Reinstatement of Kristin C. Castle received on April 8, 2015.")
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The petition must be filed/received by the Office; the filing date is recorded and relevant to the review. While this page does not specify required contents of the petition, submission of a petition is the initiating procedural requirement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Director's review of the petition and record material
rubrics_metrics.description: The Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline reviews the petition and all information in the record material relevant to eligibility for reinstatement. (Page states: "After careful review of the Petition and all information in the record material to Ms. Castle's eligibility for reinstatement, the Director ... has determined ... reinstatement ... is appropriate.")
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reinstatement decisions are based on a substantive review of the petition plus any record material bearing on eligibility. The Director exercises discretionary judgment after considering the record; the page does not detail evaluation factors beyond compliance with § 11.58 and review of record material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decision to grant reinstatement
rubrics_metrics.description: If the Director determines reinstatement is appropriate, the petition may be granted. (Page: "Accordingly, the Petition is hereby GRANTED.")
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Office issues a formal decision granting reinstatement when the Director finds requirements satisfied. The decision is signed/issued by the Deputy General Counsel for Enrollment and Discipline and Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline. The page reflects issuance of a reinstatement order but does not specify additional conditions or post-grant steps.
